text:
Small steps, kept daily,
become distant horizons.
author: MyTV Art community

text:
Begin before you feel ready.
Momentum teaches the rest.
author: MyTV Art community

text:
Protect your attention.
It is where your future grows.
author: MyTV Art community

text:
Rest is part of the rhythm,
not a retreat from it.
author: MyTV Art community

text:
Choose the next clear step.
Then choose again.
author: MyTV Art community

text:
Your pace can be gentle
and still move you forward.
author: MyTV Art community

text:
What you practice quietly
becomes your strength.
author: MyTV Art community
